titre: 20 Agentic Use Cases of TypeSafe AI’s Jev
resume: TypeSafe AI's Jev skips text generation and returns typed decisions with calibrated probabilities. Input costs $0.042 per million tokens and output is free. We verified 20 agentic use cases, from model routing and tool-call gating to reranking and injection screening, and compared Jev with its closest open and LLM rivals. The post 20 Agentic Use Cases of TypeSafe AI’s Jev appeared first on MarkTechPost .
